notes: Adds a Custom CSS box under Design → Design — a plain textarea for your own site-wide CSS, stamped into every page's <head> on save (and instantly, via a new 'Apply CSS to all pages' sweep), the same self-healing pattern Fonts and Heading Styles already use just above it. Rules written here win ties against both of those, so it's the place for one-off overrides nothing else in Design covers. Previous: "Architect-only Settings sections were permanently invisible — fixed".
apiNote: No api.php change in 1.14.108 (entirely client-side in admin/index.html: a new Custom CSS textarea in Design → Design (#si-customcss), read/written via siteCssStripManaged()/siteCssInjectIntoHtml() — deliberately independent of designStripManaged()/designAssets()/designInjectIntoHtml() (the existing Typography/Heading-styles stamp) rather than threading a third argument through those, since that trio already has three call sites (page save, 'Apply fonts to all pages', 'Apply headings to all pages') that would all need to remember to pass along a value they don't own; the new pair strips/reinserts its own separately-marked
